Name: Alacrity

Name: Ancestral Aegis
Description: Spend all Totem Resonance for a ward and restore 5% maximum health per stack.

Name: Anvil Strike

Class Sources: Berserker; Grandmaster of Arms; Weapon Master

Description: Passive: Perfects toxin severity, potency, and coating retention.

Description: Passive: Successfully casting a healing spell in combat grants +10 Attack for three turns.

Name: Blind Fighting
Description: Passive: Reduce Blind's accuracy penalty and make Blind less likely to be inflicted.

Name: Boast

Name: Eternal Conduit
Description: The Thaumaturgist's bond with their Xenids is so strong that they gain a portion of all healing and buffs their Xenids receive, and their Xenids gain a portion of all healing and buffs the Thaumaturgist receives.
